passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

spells.name: Leap Strike
spells.description: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing physical damage if it is an enemy.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Empower
spells.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Counter Strike
spells.description: Jax enters a defensive stance for up to seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking % less damage from area of effect Abilities. After seconds or Recasting, Jax deals + % max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for second. The damage is increased by % per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of + % max Health.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
spells.description: Passive: Every third Attack within seconds deals an additional magic damage. Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains Armor and Magic Resist plus Armor and Magic Resist per additional champion hit for seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.
